title: Can Social Ontological Knowledge Representations be Measured Using Machine Learning?
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It proposes a method to measure 'Personal Social Ontology' (PSO) based on concepts like fairness, agency, and cooperation.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as religion is not a subject of its analysis.
